adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff now applies `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` for all groups and passes it directly into `group.users...limit(limit)` with no upper bound. Since this is a public (non-admin) endpoint guarded only by `ensure_can_see!`, a client can request an extremely large `limit` (e.g. `?limit=1000000`), forcing a very large query and serialization workload in one request. The old code at least constrained pagination to automatic groups and had a lower default path; the new code removes any implicit guardrails and does not introduce a maximum cap.
